events.event_name: Smart Fashion Day @ New York Fashion Week
events.address: Adelphi University Manhattan Center, 529 Fifth Ave, New York, NY 10017
events.what_it_is: A Fashion Tech startup pitch competition and networking program focused on AI, fashion, luxury, retail and e-commerce during NYFW.
events.what_is_free: General Admission has a $0 public request-to-join path, but attendance is subject to host approval.
events.caveats: APPROVAL REQUIRED: Luma explicitly marks General Admission as Require Approval and uses a Request to Join flow. A request is not a confirmed admission. Bring photo ID for building security if approved.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 from 3:30–6:30 PM. Entrance is on East 44th Street between Madison and Fifth Avenue; after lobby security, take the right-side elevators to the 2nd floor.

events.address: Astor Place, 26 Astor Pl, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A two-day Reese's and The Nitro Bar truck activation debuting the Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Latte with Halloween-themed giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Up to 1,000 Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Lattes are advertised free each day, each with a recipe card and Reese's Pumpkins. The first 100 guests each day can also receive a limited-edition koozie.
events.caveats: Walk-in and open to the public. Promotional inventory is limited: the organizers describe service as starting at 11 AM and continuing until supplies last, with up to 1,000 lattes per day.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 and Tuesday, September 15 at Astor Place in front of 26 Astor Place. Arrive early because the free items are inventory-limited.

events.event_name: Mary Kay ‘Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared’ Experience
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: An oversized public beauty activation with product giveaways, beauty touch-ups and interactive photo moments during NYFW.
events.what_is_free: Mary Kay advertises 10,000 free makeup and skin-care products, plus beauty touch-ups and the public experience.
events.caveats: The event is advertised as free and open to the public. Eventbrite offers a ticket/registration path, but current public listings do not state organizer approval. Giveaway inventory is finite.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza. The Eventbrite listing is organized by Mary Kay U.S.

events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A branded NYFW truck introducing eos Dewy Lip Shine with product sampling, sweet treats and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Free Dewy Lip Shine and treats are advertised while supplies last. The first 50 guests are advertised to receive a jelly bag with the full Dewy Lip Shine collection.
events.caveats: Open to the public and first-come, first-served. Samples, ice pops and the first-50 full-collection jelly bags are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway in SoHo. No advance RSVP requirement is published in the verified sources.
